title: 第25章 巨蟹座和蟹棒
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“好了。”

    不知过了多久，陆沉的声音从身后传来。

    但林曦没有回头。

    “等，等个人过来。”

    陆沉：“？？？！”

    面对陆沉的疑惑，林曦没有解释，一直保持沉默。

    直到……魅姬那细枝结硕果的身影出现。

    “不是，你们俩什么意……”

    ……

    林天的修炼室外。

    陆沉已经在此等候多时了。

    林曦和魅姬，也已经离开了这里，说是有宗门急事，先回去了，让他一会儿给林天说一下。

    陆沉对此，也只能照做。

    他大概能猜到，应该就是白莲教内部，会出现自己的子嗣，但具体是谁，他也不知道。

    不过无所谓了，等这次回去，自己就宣布闭关突破金丹，到时候谁也不见，谁也不理。

    到时候出关，也不知道是多少年后了，那时候想必很多事情都会被时间遗忘。

    至于这次请人吃蟹棒这件事，他和客人想必会永远都藏在心里。

    毕竟这是地球的美食，放到这个世界上，别人肯定见都没见过！

    对了，他是巨蟹座。

    ……

    又等了几天，林天炼化了魅姬给他的魔纹出关，陆沉解释了一下缘由，便和林天一起回玄天宗了。

    林天本来还想玩，不想面对冷着脸的庄静白。

    但陆沉执意回去闭关突破，这是大事，他这个做师兄的，肯定要表示表示，也就一道和他回去了。

    两人御剑落在玄天宗门前的时候，天已经快黑了。

    “总算回来了，你是不知道，这几天静白给我发了十几条传讯，有时候很生气，有时候又催我快回来，真是难以理解……”

    陆沉心不在焉地应了一声。

    因为庄静白给他发了几千条轰炸。

    生气是因为自己懒得理她，催林天回来，是因为她想让自己回来……

    “对了，王师兄说，咱们回来之后，就去张帆那儿，说是出事了！”

    “那咱们快去看看吧！”

    陆沉闻言，心里隐隐有一种不好的预感。
content_en:
"Okay."

After an unknown amount of time, Lu Chen's voice came from behind.

But Lin Xi didn't look back.

"Wait, wait for someone to come over."

Lu Chen: "???!!"

Faced with Lu Chen's doubts, Lin Xi did not explain and remained silent.

Until... Mei Ji's thin branches bearing fruit appeared.

"No, what do you two mean..."

…

Outside Lin Tian's training room.

Lu Chen has been waiting here for a long time.

Lin Xi and Mei Ji have also left here, saying that they have urgent matters for the sect and are going back first, asking him to tell Lin Tian later.

Lu Chen could only do this.

He could probably guess that his descendants would appear within the White Lotus Sect, but he didn't know who they were.

But it doesn't matter. When I go back this time, I will announce that I will retreat and break through the golden elixir. Then I won't see anyone or pay attention to anyone.

I don’t know how many years it will be when I leave seclusion. At that time, many things will be forgotten by time.

As for the matter of treating people to crab sticks this time, he and his guests will definitely keep it in their hearts forever.

After all, this is the delicacy of the earth. If you put it in this world, no one else has ever seen it!

By the way, he's a Cancer.

…

After waiting for a few more days, Lin Tian refined the magic pattern given to him by Mei Ji and came out of seclusion. Lu Chen explained the reason and then returned to Xuantian Sect with Lin Tian.

Lin Tian originally wanted to play, but didn't want to face the cold-faced Zhuang Jingbai.

But Lu Chen insisted on going back to seclusion to break through. This was a big deal. As a senior brother, he must express his gratitude, so he went back with him.

When the two swords landed in front of the Xuantian Sect, it was almost dark.

"I'm finally back. You don't know. Jingbai has sent me more than a dozen messages in the past few days. Sometimes she is very angry, and sometimes she urges me to come back soon. It's really hard to understand..."

Lu Chen responded absently.

Because Zhuang Jingbai sent him thousands of bomb messages.

She was angry because she was too lazy to pay attention to her, and urged Lin Tian to come back because she wanted her to come back...

"By the way, Senior Brother Wang said that when we come back, we will go to Zhang Fan's place and tell him that something happened!"

"Then let's go and take a look!"

When Lu Chen heard this, he had a bad feeling in his heart.
